deadline.value: Doctoral applications for Fall entry are due February 15, and the catalog says they are reviewed on a rolling basis.

also.quote: Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis.

entry_route.value: The graduate school sets 72 hours for a PhD after a bachelor's and 42 after a master's, so both routes are open.
entry_route.quote: Students who do not hold a master’s degree will be required to complete a minimum of seventy-two hours of graduate credit

funding.value: Teaching assistantships are competitively awarded to excellent applicants with a faculty mentor.
funding.quote: Competitively awarded graduate teaching assistantships are available for excellent applicants with an identified faculty mentor.

gre_subject.value: Biology has no GRE Subject test.

supervisor.value: The catalog asks for an identified faculty mentor, but does not say the mentor must agree before admission.

notes: The catalog page has no GRE or English rule.
